description_en: Invoke DeleteFolder to delete a folder on the Data Development page
description_zh: 调用DeleteFolder删除数据开发页面的文件夹
name: DeleteFolder

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the ID. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间名称。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The folder ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173955.html operation to obtain the folder ID
parameters.help_zh:
文件夹的ID，
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173955.html查询对应文件夹的ID
parameters.name: folder_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for troubleshooting when an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: success.

false: failure
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
